upstream.historyScope: one entry returned by path-specific GitHub commit history at observation; not a rights or retroactivity ruling

method.local: git --no-replace-objects ls-tree -r -z at exact committed source
method.upstream: GitHub recursive Git tree API at three immutable commits; all truncated:false; LICENSE blob decoded and SHA256 checked
method.comparison: same-path Git blob identity and cross-path matches, no checkout/newclone or media download
method.absenceScope: no root LICENSE entry at recorded fork; component MIT metadata recorded separately
method.classification: mechanical comparison only; not rights/author/notice applicability or license coverage classes
notAudited: full hunk lineage of modified files
whole Git history or current deployment/runtime

assetReview.selection: tracked .webp/.mp4/.png/.svg only; not complete embedded asset/reference scan
assetReview.generation: no new image/media generation; existing source metadata only

disposition.sourceAbsenceClaim: the dated fork-root absence is supported; a claim that current upstream lacks a root license is contradicted
disposition.rootLicenseChoice: Frank owns app/original software/lore choice; no license file changed
disposition.reuse: pending component applicability, notices, hunk lineage, assets, provider terms and owner review; exact blob equality alone clears nothing
disposition.release: not approved; no dependency/import/build/install/deployment/publish/archive or private/public setting change
disposition.strategy: retain existing media owner while recording recovery and required attribution; prefer a bounded adapter to a pinned reviewed current upstream or existing accepted app media service over maintaining another broad public Arcanea fork; final integration requires measured workflow and owner acceptance
